end.summary: Practised regional diversity in food, dress, languages and festivals.
end.parentNote: Riya practised explaining how different regional forms can share an underlying idea, using Diwali, Pongal, Lohri and Baisakhi. They initially mixed up shared threads with festivals happening at the same time, then corrected this by identifying shared seasonal celebration with different customs. At home, ask them to give one “same idea, different form” example from two festivals.
